context.person: A person using a rail travel application
context.user_goal: Use station directions, including the east elevator for step-free access.

product_state.preceding_state: A train departing in 18 minutes was moved to a platform across the station.
product_state.current_state: Train 624 now departs from Platform 11. The departure time remains 5:42 PM.
known_facts: Step-free access to Platform 11 is available by the east elevator.
forbidden_claims: The east elevator is out of service.

current_content.title: An update
current_content.body: Open the app for more information.

challenge: Rewrite the mobile push notification so the person can understand train platform changed, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.secondary_action: Dismiss the alert without changing the ticket.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The traveler must reach a different platform before the unchanged departure time.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Use station directions, including the east elevator for step-free access.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
